title: AGENT-PROGRAM-002A: post-trial failure census; no Agent 002
intent: Evidence-to-design increment only. Record independently verified post-trial incidents, classify existing-control coverage, and freeze the terminal decision INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Does not implement Agent 002, does not create an authority contract, and does not change Grounding Agent v0.1 behavior.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds the 002A post-trial review, a read-only incident ledger, a stdlib summary utility plus tests, and trial row GA-TRIAL-0006 (MATCH/PROCEED). Terminal decision is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. No Agent 002 contract file is added.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The Grounding trial ledger measures Grounding KEEP/REVISE/RETIRE. It does not classify whether a second agent is warranted. This increment is that missing evidence review.
